tolerance.basis: ITTC-1978 roughness allowance is a correlation allowance; the standard itself carries O(2%) scatter against full-scale trials

source.doc: ITTC 1978 Performance Prediction Method, Recommended Procedure 7.5-02-03-01.4 (roughness allowance term)
source.access_note: formula as reproduced in the ITTC procedure; stated applicability 1e-6 <= ks/L <= 1e-4 (digitised range)

sha256_scope: sha256 over the archived digitisation artefact (sources/ittc1978.dcf_roughness_allowance.csv), i.e. the byte-exact table this entry serves; no page image of the source document is held in-repo, so the anchor does not claim pixel-level provenance

validity_range.note: ks/L outside [1e-6, 1e-4] is an extrapolation of the 1978 fit and is refused (OUT_OF_RANGE)

dual_pass.note: pass A = machine-precision transcription of the published closed form; pass B = re-typed at printed precision (5-6 s.f.) with an independent format convention. Human double-keying is NOT claimed.

verification.method: monotonicity + endpoint sanity: dCf(ks/L=1e-6)=0.41e-3 and dCf(1e-4)=4.23e-3, i.e. the 1978 fit returns the published 0.4e-3..4e-3 band over its stated applicability

notes: Roughness allowance is what turns a smooth-plate Cf into a ship Cf; used by W8-N06/N07 resistance chains.
